fields.title: 📖 ʿAqīdah: Allah will be seen in the Hereafter
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“The Prophet ﷺ said in meaning: You will see your Lord as you see this moon; you will not be pressed together in the seeing.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Ahlus-Sunnah affirms what the clear text affirms: The believers see Allah in the Hereafter, without asking about the how.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb at-Tawḥīd, Bāb: Qawl Allah Taʿālā Wujūhun Yawmaʾidhin Nāḍirah.
